a: Ubiquitous language is shared vocabulary between domain experts and developers.
Aggregate roots are the entry points for modifying aggregates.
Domain services hold domain logic that does not fit an entity.
Events reduce direct coupling between services.
UIs may need to handle briefly stale data gracefully.
Schema registries manage evolving event schemas.
DLQs hold messages that failed processing repeatedly.
Poison messages consistently fail and need special handling.
